title: Baby on Quilted Pillow by Television, 1960 B&W Snapshot Photo
description: A July 1960 black-and-white home snapshot showing an infant dressed in a hooded white onesie resting peacefully on a satin-trimmed quilted pillow on a living room carpet. In the shadowed background, a mid-century television set rests on slender legs in front of pleated window drapes, presenting an authentic glimpse into suburban domestic family life in early 1960s America.
